entries.en: Areometry allowed the analyst to compare the relative densities of two liquids.
entries.zh: 液体比重测定法使分析人员能够比较两种液体的相对密度。

entries.meaningZh: 古雅典最高法院法官的
entries.en: The paper examined Areopagitic judges and the authority they exercised in ancient Athens.
entries.zh: 这篇论文考察了古雅典最高法院法官以及他们在古雅典行使的权力。

entries.en: Her essay connects Areopagitica with later debates about freedom of the press.
entries.zh: 她的文章把《论出版自由》与后来关于出版自由的讨论联系起来。

entries.en: The laboratory's areosaccharimeter measured the relative density of the sugar solution.
entries.zh: 实验室的糖液比重计测量了糖溶液的相对密度。

entries.en: The chemical index listed Aretit as a name for dinoseb acetate, not for dinoseb itself.
entries.zh: 化学索引将 Aretit 列为地乐酯的名称，而不是地乐酚本身的名称。

entries.en: We spent a quiet afternoon exploring Arezzo, an Italian city.
entries.zh: 我们花了一个宁静的下午游览意大利城市阿雷佐。

entries.en: Dark arfvedsonite crystals stood out against the pale rock surrounding them.
entries.zh: 深色的钠角闪石晶体在周围浅色岩石的衬托下格外显眼。

entries.en: The museum label identified the tick's genus as Argas, without naming its species.
entries.zh: 博物馆的标签注明这只蜱属于锐缘蜱属，但没有写明它的种。

entries.en: The identification key placed the soft tick in the family Argasidae.
entries.zh: 检索表将这只软蜱归入隐喙蜱科。

entries.en: The older catalogue grouped those specimens under Argasinae, a subfamily of ticks.
entries.zh: 那本较早的目录将那些标本归入蜱类的一个亚科——隐喙蜱亚科。

entries.en: The reference identified argemonine as an isoquinoline alkaloid without specifying which stereoisomer was present.
entries.zh: 参考资料将蓟罂粟碱归为异喹啉生物碱，但没有说明存在的是哪种立体异构体。

entries.en: The pathologist noted argentaffin granules in the cell's cytoplasm.
entries.zh: 病理学家注意到该细胞的细胞质中有嗜银颗粒。

entries.en: The restorer described the pale metal buckle as argentan, or nickel silver.
entries.zh: 修复人员说，那个浅色金属扣是新银，也就是白铜制成的。

entries.en: Argentation gave the copper ornament a thin silver coating.
entries.zh: 镀银使那件铜饰品表面有了一层薄薄的银。

entries.en: Our train reached Argenteuil, a French town, just before sunset.
entries.zh: 我们的列车在日落前不久抵达法国城镇阿让特伊。

entries.en: The reference collection included several fish assigned to the family Argentinidae.
entries.zh: 参考标本集中有几条被归入水珍鱼科的鱼。

entries.en: The geologist identified the silver-bearing mineral in the sample as argentojarosite.
entries.zh: 地质学家将样本中含银的矿物鉴定为银铁矾。

entries.en: The histology notes described the tissue's scattered cells as argentophil.
entries.zh: 组织学笔记将该组织中零散分布的细胞描述为嗜银细胞。

entries.en: The alchemist recorded the weight of argentum, or silver, in the ledger.
entries.zh: 炼金术士在账簿中记录了 argentum，也就是银的重量。

entries.en: The entomologist identified the sawfly as a member of Argidae.
entries.zh: 昆虫学家鉴定这只叶蜂属于三节叶蜂科。

entries.en: Arginase is the enzyme that breaks arginine into ornithine and urea.
entries.zh: 精氨酸酶是将精氨酸分解为鸟氨酸和尿素的酶。

entries.en: Argininemia is an inherited disorder affecting the body's handling of arginine.
entries.zh: 精氨酸血症是一种影响人体精氨酸代谢的遗传性疾病。

entries.en: The spider was identified as Argiope, but its species remained uncertain.
entries.zh: 这只蜘蛛被鉴定为金蛛属，但它的种仍未确定。

entries.en: Crystals of argol, or crude tartar, had formed inside the old wine barrel.
entries.zh: 旧酒桶内已经形成了 argol，也就是粗酒石的晶体。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔戈利斯〔希腊东南部地区〕
entries.en: Her photographs of Argolis included coastal scenes from southeastern Greece.
entries.zh: 她拍摄的阿尔戈利斯照片中，有希腊东南部的海岸风光。

entries.en: The zoology text placed the paper nautiluses in the family Argonautidae.
entries.zh: 那本动物学教材将船蛸归入船蛸科。

entries.en: The bird label gave the genus as Argusianus and identified it as a pheasant.
entries.zh: 鸟类标本的标签注明它的属为大眼斑雉属，并说明它是一种雉。

entries.en: The field guide placed the orange butterfly in the genus Argynnis.
entries.zh: 野外图鉴将那只橙色蝴蝶归入豹蛱蝶属。

entries.en: An Argyranthemum beside the gate was covered in white, daisy-like flowers.
entries.zh: 门旁的一株木茼蒿属植物开满了形似雏菊的白花。

entries.en: The botanist identified the climbing plant as a member of Argyreia.
entries.zh: 植物学家鉴定那株攀缘植物属于银背藤属。

entries.en: The glossary explained that the argyric salts were compounds of silver.
entries.zh: 术语表解释说，这些银盐是银的化合物。

entries.en: The museum identified argyrol as a mild silver protein preparation, not as pure silver.
entries.zh: 博物馆说明，argyrol 是一种弱蛋白银制剂，而不是纯银。

entries.en: The eye examination revealed argyrosis, with silver deposits in the ocular tissues.
entries.zh: 眼部检查发现了银质沉着病，眼组织中有银沉积。

entries.en: The moth collection included a specimen assigned to the genus Argyrotaenia.
entries.zh: 蛾类收藏中有一件归入带卷蛾属的标本。

entries.en: The botanist photographed Argyroxiphium, a genus of flowering plants, without disturbing the specimens.
entries.zh: 植物学家拍摄了开花植物的一个属——剑叶菊属，而没有扰动那些植株。

entries.en: The medical illustration showed arhinia, a congenital absence of the nose.
entries.zh: 医学插图展示了无鼻畸形，即先天性鼻缺如。

entries.en: The older classification placed leeches without a proboscis in the order Arhynchobdellae.
entries.zh: 那套较早的分类法将没有吻的蛭类归入无吻蛭目。

entries.en: The ruler tried to Arianise the church, but several bishops resisted the change.
entries.zh: 统治者试图使教会信奉阿里乌教义，但几位主教抵制了这一改变。

entries.en: The index treated aribine as another name for harman, rather than as a separate compound.
entries.zh: 索引将 aribine 视为哈尔满的另一个名称，而不是另一种化合物。

entries.en: An old news report described an ASBO issued against a persistently noisy neighbour.
entries.zh: 一篇旧新闻报道讲述了针对一名持续制造噪声的邻居签发的反社会行为令。

entries.en: Poor battery life proved to be the camera's Achilles heel during the trip.
entries.zh: 旅途中，电池续航差成了这台相机的致命弱点。

entries.en: Her grandfather had Alzheimer's disease, so the family arranged regular visits and familiar routines.
entries.zh: 她的祖父患有阿耳滋海默氏病，因此家人安排了定期探望和他熟悉的日常活动。

entries.en: The Art Nouveau doorway had curved metalwork that echoed the stems of plants.
entries.zh: 那扇新艺术主义风格的门有弯曲的金属装饰，形状呼应了植物的茎。

entries.en: We watched a B-movie with shaky sets and a wonderfully absurd plot.
entries.zh: 我们看了一部布景摇摇晃晃、剧情荒诞得妙不可言的廉价电影。

entries.en: She had always wanted to see the Big Apple, especially its busy streets.
entries.zh: 她一直想去看看纽约，尤其是那里繁忙的街道。

entries.en: As a British Asian, she grew up speaking English and Punjabi at home.
entries.zh: 作为一名英籍亚洲人，她从小在家里说英语和旁遮普语。

entries.en: He rediscovered Britpop while sorting through the albums he loved at school.
entries.zh: 整理学生时代喜爱的唱片时，他重新发现了英伦摇滚的魅力。

entries.en: The C-in-C asked the officers for a clear account of the situation.
entries.zh: 总司令要求军官们清楚地说明情况。

entries.en: The old computer needed an external CD writer to burn the photographs onto a disc.
entries.zh: 那台旧电脑需要一台外置光盘刻录机，才能将照片刻录到光盘上。

entries.en: The news footage showed people moving away from a cloud of CS gas.
entries.zh: 新闻画面显示，人们正远离一团催泪瓦斯。

entries.en: The Chief Justice listened without interruption while the lawyer explained her argument.
entries.zh: 律师阐述论点时，首席法官一直倾听，没有打断她。

entries.en: The witnesses waited outside the Crown Court until their names were called.
entries.zh: 证人们在英国刑事法庭外等候，直到有人叫到他们的名字。

entries.en: The Crown Prince greeted the guests before the formal dinner began.
entries.zh: 正式晚宴开始前，皇储向宾客们致意。

entries.en: The documentary explained how DNA fingerprinting can help distinguish one individual from another.
entries.zh: 纪录片解释了 DNA 指纹分析如何有助于区分不同个体。

entries.en: She bought a Danish pastry with her coffee and saved half for later.
entries.zh: 她买咖啡时买了一块丹麦甜糕饼，留下一半稍后再吃。

entries.en: The sign painter used Day-Glo to make the lettering vivid in daylight.
entries.zh: 招牌绘制者用幻彩荧光漆，使字样在日光下鲜艳醒目。

entries.en: A Denver boot clamped around the wheel prevented him from driving the car away.
entries.zh: 锁在车轮上的丹佛锁扣使他无法把汽车开走。

entries.en: The District Attorney declined to discuss the case while the hearing was still under way.
entries.zh: 听证会尚在进行时，地方检察官拒绝讨论这起案件。

entries.en: The old economic commentary used Euroland for the countries sharing the euro.
entries.zh: 那篇旧经济评论用 Euroland 指共同使用欧元的国家。

entries.en: Her report compared prices inside the Eurozone with prices in neighbouring economies.
entries.zh: 她的报告比较了欧元区内与邻近经济体的物价。

entries.en: The essay compared living conditions in the First World with those elsewhere.
entries.zh: 这篇文章比较了第一世界与其他地区的生活条件。

entries.en: As a Girl Guide, she learned to plan a route and work with others.
entries.zh: 作为女童子军成员，她学会了规划路线和与他人合作。

entries.en: God willing, we will finish the repairs before the next storm arrives.
entries.zh: 如果情况允许，我们会在下一场暴风雨到来前完成维修。

entries.en: The Governor-General welcomed the visitors and thanked the volunteers for their work.
entries.zh: 总督欢迎了来访者，并感谢志愿者们的工作。

entries.en: With the bases loaded, he hit a grand slam over the centre-field fence.
entries.zh: 满垒时，他将球击过中外野围栏，打出了一记满垒全垒打。

entries.en: The High Commissioner met the students before opening the cultural exhibition.
entries.zh: 高级专员在为文化展览揭幕之前会见了学生们。

entries.en: The museum display showed how glaciers shaped the valley during the Ice Age.
entries.zh: 博物馆的展览展示了冰川在冰河时代如何塑造这条山谷。

entries.en: The family exchanged letters across the Iron Curtain despite long delays.
entries.zh: 尽管书信经常延误很久，这家人仍跨越铁幕相互通信。

entries.en: A Justice of the Peace witnessed the signature on her application.
entries.zh: 一名治安法官见证了她在申请书上的签名。

entries.en: The Liberal Democrat at the meeting challenged the council's plans for the park.
entries.zh: 会上，那名自由民主党成员对市政委员会的公园规划提出了质疑。

entries.en: Her younger brother joined Little League and spent Saturday mornings practising with his team.
entries.zh: 她的弟弟加入了少年棒球联合会，每周六上午都与队友一起训练。

entries.en: The Member of Congress met local residents to hear their concerns about housing.
entries.zh: 那位国会议员会见了当地居民，听取他们对住房问题的关切。

entries.en: A Mexican wave travelled around the stadium while the players waited for the restart.
entries.zh: 球员们等待比赛重新开始时，一阵看台人浪绕着体育场传开。

entries.en: The child recognised Mickey Mouse on the lunchbox and grinned.
entries.zh: 孩子认出了午餐盒上的米老鼠，咧嘴笑了起来。

entries.meaningZh: 英国中产阶级〔尤指政治上保守的人群〕
entries.en: The columnist argued that the proposal was designed to appeal to Middle England.
entries.zh: 专栏作家认为，这项提案旨在吸引英国中产阶级，尤其是其中政治上保守的人群。

entries.en: He moved from the Middle West to the coast after university.
entries.zh: 大学毕业后，他从美国中西部搬到了沿海地区。

entries.en: She grew up in the Midlands but moved to London for work.
entries.zh: 她在英国中部长大，后来为了工作搬到了伦敦。

entries.en: After the rain ruined our picnic, we joked that Mother Nature had other ideas.
entries.zh: 野餐被雨水搅黄后，我们开玩笑说大自然另有打算。

entries.en: The Mother Superior invited the visitors to wait quietly in the courtyard.
entries.zh: 女修道院院长请来访者在庭院里安静等候。

entries.meaningZh: 拜望双亲日〔英国的母亲节〕
entries.en: They returned to the family home for Mothering Sunday and shared a meal.
entries.zh: 他们在英国母亲节回到家中，一起吃了顿饭。

entries.en: The leaflet described the National Health Service and explained where to find local information.
entries.zh: 传单介绍了国家医疗保健机构，并说明可以在哪里找到当地的相关信息。

entries.en: The small chapel contained a painting of Our Lady beside the altar.
entries.zh: 小礼拜堂的祭坛旁有一幅圣母玛丽亚的画像。

entries.en: The painting above the altar showed Our Lord surrounded by his disciples.
entries.zh: 祭坛上方的画描绘了基督被门徒围绕的情景。

entries.en: They made lemon pancakes together on Pancake Day.
entries.zh: 他们在薄饼日一起做了柠檬薄饼。

entries.en: Photofit helped the investigators assemble a face from the witness's description.
entries.zh: 照片拼凑人像法帮助调查人员根据证人的描述拼出了一张人脸。

entries.en: She joked that her Prince Charming would need to enjoy long walks in the rain.
entries.zh: 她开玩笑说，她理想中的求婚者得喜欢在雨中长时间散步。

entries.en: The archive contained a letter addressed to the Privy Council about the disputed appointment.
entries.zh: 档案中有一封写给枢密院的信，内容涉及那项有争议的任命。

entries.en: Red Crescent volunteers helped families find shelter after the flood.
entries.zh: 洪水过后，红新月会的志愿者帮助各家各户寻找避难处。

entries.en: The form recorded the patient's blood group and Rh factor in separate boxes.
entries.zh: 表格在不同的方框中记录了患者的血型和 Rh 因子。

entries.en: She addressed the visiting prince as Your Royal Highness before beginning her speech.
entries.zh: 开始演讲前，她称呼来访的王子为殿下。

entries.meaningZh: 爱尔兰北部苏格兰移民后裔的
entries.en: Her Scotch-Irish grandparents kept a handwritten record of the family's journey across the Atlantic.
entries.zh: 她的祖父母是爱尔兰北部苏格兰移民的后裔，保存着一份记述家族横渡大西洋经历的手写记录。

entries.en: The Sovietologist compared official speeches with private letters from the same period.
entries.zh: 这位苏联问题专家比较了同一时期的官方演说和私人信件。

entries.en: The survey covered a square mile of woodland beyond the village.
entries.zh: 调查覆盖了村外一平方英里的林地。

entries.meaningZh: 面向其他语言使用者的英语教学
entries.en: Her TESOL course included practice in planning lessons for multilingual classrooms.
entries.zh: 她修读的面向其他语言使用者的英语教学课程，包括为多语言课堂设计课程的练习。

entries.en: We shared a plate of Tex-Mex after the film and talked until closing time.
entries.zh: 电影结束后，我们分吃了一盘美墨边境风味的食物，一直聊到打烊。

entries.meaningZh: 职工大会〔英国工会联合组织〕
entries.en: The Trades Union Congress brings unions together to speak on behalf of working people.
entries.zh: 英国职工大会把各工会联合起来，为劳动者发声。

entries.en: The bill returned to the Upper House after further debate in the lower chamber.
entries.zh: 下议院进一步辩论后，该法案被送回上议院。

entries.en: The jumper's V-neck sat neatly over the collar of her white shirt.
entries.zh: 毛衣的 V 型领整齐地套在她白衬衫的领子外。

entries.en: He raised a V-sign towards the camera as the winners lined up.
entries.zh: 获奖者列队时，他朝着镜头举起了 V 字手势。

entries.en: The museum displayed a West German camera from the years before reunification.
entries.zh: 博物馆展出了一台德国统一前的西德相机。

entries.en: The choir rehearsed a new piece for the service on Whit Sunday.
entries.zh: 唱诗班为圣灵降临节的礼拜排练了一首新曲。

entries.en: The committee studied the White Paper before submitting its response to the government.
entries.zh: 委员会研究了白皮书，然后向政府提交了回应。

entries.en: The local YWCA offered a quiet room where volunteers could meet and plan activities.
entries.zh: 当地基督教女青年会提供了一间安静的房间，让志愿者们开会并筹划活动。

entries.meaningZh: 牙买加犯罪组织成员〔俚语，含贬义〕
entries.en: The Yardie in the crime novel used threats to protect the gang's drug trade.
entries.zh: 那本犯罪小说中的牙买加犯罪组织成员用威胁手段维护帮派的毒品交易。

entries.en: He was known as a man of God who listened patiently to troubled neighbours.
entries.zh: 他被认为是一位圣职人员，总会耐心倾听心有困扰的邻居诉说。

entries.en: An air ambulance carried the injured climber to hospital before nightfall.
entries.zh: 一架救护飞机在天黑前将受伤的登山者送到了医院。

entries.en: The appendices contain the survey questions and a detailed explanation of the calculations.
entries.zh: 附录包含调查问题，以及对计算过程的详细说明。

entries.en: The team was working at full blast to finish the scenery before opening night.
entries.zh: 团队正热火朝天地赶工，力求在首演之夜前完成舞台布景。

entries.en: The announcement was delayed at someone's request, though nobody would say whose.
entries.zh: 应某人的请求，公告推迟发布了，不过谁也不肯说是谁提出的请求。

entries.en: The audio-visual equipment failed just as the lecturer started the presentation.
entries.zh: 讲师刚开始演示，视听设备就出故障了。

entries.en: We had to operate below strength while several members of the team were away.
entries.zh: 团队中有几名成员不在期间，我们不得不在缺员的情况下运作。

entries.en: The analyst recorded the bicarbonate result under bicarb in the worksheet.
entries.zh: 分析人员把重碳酸盐的结果记在工作表的 bicarb 栏下。

entries.en: The mechanic ordered a bolt-on bracket so the frame would not need welding.
entries.zh: 机械师订购了一个用螺栓紧固的支架，这样就不必焊接框架了。

entries.en: She labelled the container of breast milk before leaving it with the baby's caregiver.
entries.zh: 她给装母乳的容器贴好标签，然后将它交给照顾婴儿的人。

entries.en: The parents' group discussed breast-feeding and shared questions with a visiting nurse.
entries.zh: 家长小组讨论了母乳喂养，并向来访的护士提出了问题。

entries.en: Her bruised knee looked purple, but she was more upset about the torn trousers.
entries.zh: 她青肿的膝盖看起来发紫，但她更心疼破掉的裤子。

entries.en: The charge nurse coordinated the ward team when the next shift arrived.
entries.zh: 下一班人员到岗时，病室主管护士协调了病区团队的工作。

entries.en: The diagram showed a club foot twisted inward and downward.
entries.zh: 图中展示了一只向内、向下扭转的畸形足。

entries.en: The development team chose a code name for the project before announcing its public name.
entries.zh: 开发团队在公布项目的正式名称之前，先为它选了一个代号。

entries.en: The doctor opened the consulting room door and called the next patient.
entries.zh: 医生打开诊察室的门，叫下一位患者进来。

entries.en: The observatory's detector recorded cosmic rays rather than light from the nearby street.
entries.zh: 天文台的探测器记录的是宇宙线，而不是附近街道的灯光。

entries.en: The cross-legged child listened quietly while her grandfather read the story.
entries.zh: 祖父读故事时，那个盘腿坐着的孩子安静地听着。

entries.en: The family kept the death certificate with the other official papers.
entries.zh: 家人将死亡证与其他官方文件保存在一起。

entries.en: He waited outside the delivery room while his older sister was giving birth.
entries.zh: 姐姐分娩时，他在产房外等候。

entries.en: This sample of depleted uranium contained a smaller proportion of uranium-235 than natural uranium.
entries.zh: 这份贫化铀样本中铀-235 的比例低于天然铀。

entries.en: A quiet cottage with a small garden would suit her down to the ground.
entries.zh: 一栋带小花园的安静小屋会完全合她的心意。

entries.en: The mechanic found a crack in the drive shaft and stopped the test.
entries.zh: 机械师发现传动轴上有一道裂纹，于是停止了测试。

entries.en: The dropping of the curtain marked the end of the performance.
entries.zh: 幕布的落下标志着演出结束。

entries.en: The council fenced off the dumping ground to stop rubbish spreading into the stream.
entries.zh: 市政委员会用围栏围住垃圾场，防止垃圾散落到溪流中。

entries.en: A quick dusting of the shelves made the room look much tidier.
entries.zh: 把架子上的灰快速擦了一遍后，房间显得整洁多了。

entries.en: The dentist used a diagram to show where the upper eye teeth sit.
entries.zh: 牙医用一幅图说明上尖牙的位置。

entries.en: The anatomy model showed each fallopian tube extending from the uterus towards an ovary.
entries.zh: 解剖模型展示了每条输卵管从子宫向一侧卵巢延伸的样子。

entries.en: When the war began, they moved to the village and stayed there for the duration.
entries.zh: 战争开始后，他们搬到了村里，一直住到战争结束。

entries.en: We waited on the freezing platform with our hands tucked deep inside our pockets.
entries.zh: 我们站在严寒的站台上等候，双手深深地插在口袋里。

entries.en: Bright fungi appeared on the fallen log after several days of rain.
entries.zh: 连下几天雨后，倒下的原木上长出了色彩鲜艳的真菌。

entries.en: The detector registered gamma rays even though no visible light reached the sensor.
entries.zh: 尽管没有可见光到达传感器，探测器仍记录到了伽马射线。
